Brush character at every edge.

Whole figure from hat tip to sandals in frame with a paper margin all round.

The reference shows him from behind in a landscape: keep exactly his clothes, colours, proportions and line quality, and discard the landscape. Plain empty paper background, nothing else in the picture: no ground line, no shadow under the feet, no clouds, no text, no seal.
